Image 2 is another portrait in the set and is a reference ONLY for line weight, navy ink and general softness of the anime cel finish. Make a subtle edit to harmonize this set, at the fidelity of a paint-over. Do not redraw the face or alter the features, costume, pose, anatomy, perspective or character identity.
Specifically protect this expression and pose: Retain the exact contented uneven closed smile, relaxed half-lidded eyes, blush, original facial angle and two curled hair locks.

edits.description: Matched the middle bow’s left lobe to its existing gold right lobe.
edits.prompt: Use case: precise local color correction on an existing transparent anime illustration. Exactly one tiny color change. In the cluster of three uniform bows, the TOP bow is blue, the MIDDLE bow has a blue lobe on viewer-left and already-golden knot and right lobe, and the BOTTOM bow is already golden. Recolor ONLY that blue viewer-left lobe of the middle bow to the same muted golden yellow as the middle bow's existing viewer-right lobe, including the small blue fold shading inside the lobe so the shading reads in the same gold palette. The target is immediately above the lowest gold bow and just to the right of the large hand on viewer-left, in the small region around x=665–752, y=1010–1124 on this 1254×1254 image. Keep the top bow fully blue, existing gold knot/right lobe and bottom bow as drawn. Retain the exact original bow geometry, seams, outline and shadow structure. Protect the existing face, hair, camera framing, both V signs and all finger positions, uniform, color balance, lines and every pixel and alpha value outside the requested local color fix to the fullest extent possible. Do not shift or redraw the image, add fibers, adjust lighting or crop. Output one true RGBA-transparent 1254×1254 PNG at the same framing.

edits.description: Matched the bottom bow to the top blue bow.
edits.prompt:
Use case: precise local color correction. Edit one thing in this 1254×1254 RGBA image of Anna Yanami: recolor the entire BOTTOM / THIRD bow of the cluster from gold to the same muted light denim blue as the existing TOP bow. The bottom bow sits at x≈665–897 and y≈1080–1232, below the middle bow; its center knot is around (785,1142), distinct from the middle knot at (765,1042). Recolor its two wings, knot and internal folds, keeping their exact existing shape, contours and shading values. Match the existing top bow's color family and contrast, with darker subtle blue shadows and restrained highlights.
The final order is TOP BLUE unchanged, MIDDLE FULL GOLDEN YELLOW unchanged, BOTTOM BLUE newly recolored. At their point of overlap keep the middle bow's left and right golden wings fully gold. Preserve every other part of the original, including the two V gestures, all fingers, face, expression, blue hair, dress fabric, linework, same lighting, composition and crop. Keep outside and between hairs/fingers true alpha transparency, with the exact same 1254×1254 square canvas and no background or new objects. Do not resize, shift, distort, repaint or alter pixels outside the bottom bow to the fullest extent possible.

assets.prompt:
Use case: lighting and visual finishing of an existing Anna Yanami transparent school character portrait. Image 1 is the only edit target and shows the user's design-sheet expression drawn in anime linework. Image 2 is a portrait in the current set, for lighting, palette, line weight, and display scale reference only. Apply a carefully restrained paint-over to harmonize Image 1 with the current portrait set. 
Protect the existing identity, face, shape of features, gaze, facial shading geometry, form and precise hairstyle from Image 1. Keep the same tilted head, two happily closed eyes, blush, open laughing mouth and shoulder angle. Preserve the proportions, character construction, posture, and composition. Do not change the expression or add new elements or limbs.
Match image 2's lighting and color family: soft neutral daylight, lightly warm ivory skin with faint blue-gray shadows, medium-deep desaturated navy/denim blue hair with muted slate-blue glints, buttoned white short-sleeved pointed collar school blouse with cool subtle fold shadows, and muted blue and gold-yellow bows where in frame. To match the series, change the light-blue second ribbon in the target to muted golden yellow where visible, while keeping its same shape and existing first blue ribbon. Use fine steady deep navy and dark slate outlines, with a slightly stronger outer silhouette and finer internal lines, and a soft clean cel finish with restrained contrast. Do not add heavy gradients, shiny spots, glowing eyes, or white outlines. 
Match the current 1254 × 1254 portrait set on a true alpha-transparent square PNG canvas. Center the original head and upper chest at roughly the same bust scale as image 2; a small safety margin above the cowlick and around side locks, and a natural clean chest-level finish on the bottom. Keep all hair gaps and original exterior transparent. No background fill, stickers, shadows outside the figure, graphic marks, checkerboard or text.
